A-deer-drive-0107.name: 2.0 km S of Thompson River
A-deer-drive-0107.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
A-deer-drive-0107.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: No official deer winter range within 500 m, so the top score here is 8 of 11. This score leans on cutblocks, burns, habitat zone and aspect.
Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), right here.
Burn from 2021 (fire K71086, 83,671 ha), right here.
Habitat zone Interior Douglas fir (IDFdk2): low winter and fall range.
W facing slope, 26 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Private fields 1.7 km N: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: 4 point bucks: antlers must accompany the species licence (page footnote)

LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season

plan: Drive: from Heffley Creek, about 140 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5 (Yellowhead Hwy), Old Hwy 5, 7th St, Fortune Dr.
Park: 50.23855, -121.43147, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 160 m W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2021 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-13, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-03, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-03.
